question: Which of the following parts of VRF or VRV system is used to return oil from the oil separator to the compressor?
solution:
The correct answer is __Solenoid valve.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Solenoid valve__ is an essential component in VRF or VRV systems.
 
• It is used to return oil from the oil separator to the compressor.
 
• The solenoid valve ensures proper oil circulation within the system.
 
• It prevents oil starvation and ensures efficient operation of the compressor.
 
• By maintaining the oil flow, it helps in extending the compressor's life span.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **High pressure sensor:**

 
 
• Used to monitor the pressure within the system.
 
• It helps in detecting abnormal pressure levels to ensure safe operation.
 
 
 
• **Four-way valve:**
 
 
• Used in VRF/VRV systems for reversing the refrigerant flow.
 
• It enables the system to switch between heating and cooling modes.
 
 
 
• **Electronic expansion valve:**
 
 
• Regulates the flow of refrigerant into the evaporator.
 
• Ensures optimal system performance and energy efficiency.
